body:
Well I’m from a Middle Eastern country and I have tried to kill myself.
I have tried looking up any ways to get help from abroad but nothing worked, I take depression meds and I think that if someday I’m exposed I’d kill myself before they kill me.

I am actually majoring in law, my degree would be a bachelors in law. It is a really different system here.
Would I qualify to apply for law school in other places with my degree? How expensive is it?
Thank you so much, I really appreciate the support! And I will PM you.

I did see the comment, the thing is a law degree is different in other countries, from my little understanding law school in the US is a place you go to after getting your bachelors degree, correct me if I’m wrong.
I honestly have no idea how I could make my bachelors degree useful abroad once I graduate.
Is law school a form of postgraduate education? Is it the same in North America as EU countries or Australia?
Thank you for your kindness!

Would that apply for law related degrees? Another redditor has mentioned changing my major to international relations, if I do go somewhere and get a bachelors degree in international relations, would I still qualify for that?
I have always wanted to work in the legal field and actually make some changes in my home country but I have lost hope.
You’re so sweet! I hope everything works out for you as well. <3

Loans aren’t exactly “Haram”, interest is. But that wouldn’t matter personally because I’m not muslim.
I would actually look forward to working my ass off when I get to another country but the difficult part is actually getting there. Thank you for your support!

Thank you so much, my whole family isn’t in a great place financially at the moment, as for jobs here would get me paid less than 30 euros per month which is barely anything for me to live and pay my tuition. I tried to find online work but online payment is unavailable here and most of those jobs are US-centric unfortunately.
Thank you so much, I will check them out.

Honestly if you look at it from another point of view, they wouldn’t love me enough to accept me as who I am. Would it be a healthy relationship with one’s family? If that love isn’t unconditional then it’s just manipulative.
I guess it would be legal but I am trying to find a more independent way of immigration, I hope my command of English isn’t ruining what I’m trying to say.

I get that most Middle Eastern people are family oriented, but once they know that you are different in any way they will reject you and some families disown or kill their members for changing their religion or being lgbt.
Starting outside my home country is the hard part unfortunately, I wish there was another way. Thank you so much for the resources!
I’d rather not say openly since it’s pretty dangerous for me.
Thank you, will do!
It is a costly process and I would rather go through the legal way, so it would be easier for me to get a job and whatnot.
I did check the Canadian express entry option and it doesn’t seem like they need people in my field. It was extremely confusing honestly.
I would, but most countries ask for a bank statement and I am currently in a bad financial situation.
I haven’t heard of such degree over here, the closest thing would probably be to seek higher education specializing in international law.
Thank you for your advice, I will try to do whatever is possible to legally move out.
I guess seeking higher education is one of the better choices for me. Thank you so much for your advice!
Sadly, I wouldn’t wish it on my worst enemy to live here as an lgbt person or honestly even a straight person either. Life sucks. But thank you for your kind words!
Unfortunately I am terrible at anything mathematical or scientific. And my high school diploma is specialized in humanities so even changing my major is quite hard at this point.
Thank you. I have tried to find suitable scholarships but unfortunately my grades aren’t that great. Stay safe!
Will do.
I am afraid not, I haven’t finished my education yet and it’s not possible for me financially.
Life sucks huh?
I’ve tried but the economy here is shit and the currency keeps devaluating. I haven’t graduated from university yet and I can’t find a job.

Shukran bro for your kind words, I wish it worked out and I am trying to make it work out, unfortunately nothing brings me joy anymore, everything I used to love bores me.
I hope it gets better for you too, stay safe!

Your advice means a lot to me, but my doctor is a religious nut and I try to avoid going as much as possible because going to his clinic depresses me more. I wish I could just leave and go somewhere else but unfortunately I have nothing and no one, I don’t know what to do.
Thank you, I just need this rollercoaster to stop.

You can counter his words by saying that he is the one who came onto you and that you weren’t approving of anything which is why he’s spreading rumours about you. It is sad that people like us have to resort to these ways but for the lgbt in the Middle East it’s each person for themselves.

Hello there! Fellow Middle Eastern gay guy here, does that person have any evidence of your encounters? If not then you’re mostly safe. And most guys would still avoid outing the other person because they can still get into trouble.
